summary: Preinstall dropper downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it, chmods it executable, and uses that runtime to execute a bundled 727KB obfuscated file named `math_init.js`. The `setup.mjs` loader itself uses hex-name identifier and string-map obfuscation to hide the download URLs and executable names (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, string maps mapping keys to "bun", "bun.exe", etc.). The payload `math_init.js` is a single-line `@bun @bun-cjs`-tagged file with hex-named identifiers and a shuffled string-array rotator (`WV8StW` over table `n7gIxM`), with no readable APIs, imports, or exports. The advertised purpose is an ESLint TypeScript/React configuration, which has no legitimate need for a downloaded alternate runtime or an obfuscated multi-hundred-KB binary blob. Installing the package via `npm install` auto-runs the preinstall hook, causing the obfuscated payload to execute under a runtime that bypasses Node-focused inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
